component: message deletion stable event handler identity

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The header uses a named delete click handler and the multi-message view uses a class-field arrow handler, rather than creating a new anonymous listener on every label refresh. Current updates remove obsolete command attributes and attach the stable listener. Scoped manual recommendation: preserve listener identity across repeated state updates so registration/removal refers to the same function and does not accumulate fresh callbacks. The static inspection does not measure actual event dispatch counts. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: State refreshes retain a stable delete-button listener identity
